summary.text: Luc Jasmin III is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 3-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Natalie Poulson for an open seat.
Jasmin works as the Eastern Washington Representative in the Washington State Governor's Office and owns Parkview Early Learning Center in Spokane, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Jasmin earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Nazarene College in 2008, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as government relations.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described more than a decade of leadership roles in education, public policy and community development.
He said his work in the Governor's Office involves advocating for resources for affordable housing, childcare and access to essential services across rural and urban areas of Eastern Washington.
He listed service on community boards including Northeast Youth and Family Services, the Spokane Land Bank, Family Promise of Spokane, NAACP Spokane and 5th Avenue Forward.
Jasmin advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 32.4% of the vote, finishing second to Poulson's 33.0%.

His stated priorities include housing affordability, funding for early education and childcare, access to healthcare and senior care, and protecting reproductive, voting, privacy and immigration rights.
